call_purpose: You reached out because your customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after they bought, even though you had connected your payment gateway.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and after a test order you confirmed the confirmation email arrived in your inbox.

covered.text: The email still shows the default sender name, which is not yet resolved. We explained that you can change it under Email settings, then Sender name.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name under Email settings, then Sender name, to use your brand name.
